name: Michigan DECA chapters and state conference
org: Michigan DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter and learn business skills in marketing, management, finance, hospitality or entrepreneurship. Chapters compete at the Michigan state conference.
who_can_apply: Members must be enrolled in a marketing, management, finance, hospitality or entrepreneurship course. Grades and ages are not listed.
pay_detail: $17 per student member: $9 to the state association plus $8 to DECA Inc. Local chapter fees are not stated.
deadline_text: The Michigan DECA conference is March 11 to 13, 2027 at Huntington Place in Detroit. No membership deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's business or marketing teacher about a DECA chapter. Send state questions to the Michigan DECA advisor, Dave Wait. His email is dwait@emich.edu.
notes: Not a paid job. The state website listed on the page is mideca.org. This card is based on the DECA Inc. page for Michigan.
